texts.preamble: Inder Yadav vs State Of Jharkhand ..... Opposite Party on 14 October, 2022 Author: Deepak Roshan Bench: Deepak Roshan 1 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi Cr. Revision No. 535 of 2007 Inder Yadav ..... Petitioner Versus State of Jharkhand ..... Opposite Party --------- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Deepak Roshan --------- For the Petitioner : Mr. K.S. Nanda, Advocate For the State : Mr. S.K. Srivastava, App
texts.facts: 3. The prosecution case in brief is based upon the report submitted by the Sanitary-cum-Food Inspector, Kuju Anchal. According to the prosecution report when he along with other staff inspected the shop of the petitioner they found prepared food stuffs kept exposed for sale. It is said that on demand the petitioner did not show the licence. Several persons were present in the shop taking meal and purchasing sweets etc. Thereafter, Food Inspector prepared the prosecution report obtained sanction and filed the prosecution report. Thereafter, cognizance has been taken for the said offence; for which the petitioner pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. After trial, the petitioner was found guilty for the offence and was convicted and his appeal was also rejected by the learned appellate court.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner confines his argument on the question of sentence and submits that the petitioner remained in custody for about 80 days and he is the only earning member of his family and sending him back to prison will hamper his entire family and during entire period of bail, he never misused the privilege of bail, as such the sentence may be modified. 5. Learned counsel for the State supported the judgment and submits that there is no error in the findings given by the Courts below. As such, the conviction cannot be [LEAKAGE_MASK].
